{{Top|leg}}
The '''Ettarue arm''' was one of the spiral arms of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Braig Farool]], in the course of his involvement in the plot to kidnap the [[Shashay]] musician [[Crying Dawn Singer]] and force his people to become servants of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], expressed the opinion that his actions would lead him to become [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Rayter sector/Legends|Rayter sector]], then ruler of the Ettarue arm, and eventually the heir to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself.<ref name="The Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
